parsed.body:
Please verify the following artifacts to resolve the verification gaps identified in the system:

1. SAML-INRESP-01: Check if the SP (Identity Provider) initiated flows have no InResponseTo value, and confirm that SP initiated flows have an InResponseTo value.

2. SAML-INRESP-02: Check if the SP (Identity Provider) initiated flows have no InResponseTo value, and confirm that SP initiated flows have an InResponseTo value.

Please ensure that the verification is done using the artifacts mentioned in the gaps, and provide the results in a clear and concise manner.
